lines.en: label springtime7:
scene jillingforjesus1
: {i}Well, I hope she’s doing better than we are right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，我希望她现在过得比我们好。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}She’s probably still asleep. I can never get her out of bed this early.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她大概还在睡。这么早我从来叫不起她。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}AHH! NGHH!...AAAHHH! NO! S...STOP! PLEASE! I CAN’T...ACK...I CAN’T...BREATHE!
lines.zh: : 啊！嗯啊！……啊啊啊！不！救……停下！求你了！我喘不……啊……我喘不……上气！

lines.en: : Keep your fucking mouth shut or I’m taping it closed, bitch! You do what I fuckin’ tell you, got it?!
lines.zh: : 闭上你他妈的嘴，不然我用胶带给你封上，贱人！我让你干什么你就干什么，听懂了吗？！

lines.en: : IT HURTS! IT HURTS!...NNGAAAHHH! STOP! GET OFF OF ME! PLEASE! SOMEONE HELP!
lines.zh: : 好痛！好痛！……嗯嘎啊啊啊！停下！从我身上滚开！求你了！来人救命啊！

lines.en: : The fuck did I just tell you?! Now it’s gonna hurt even more, you fucking thirsty slut!
lines.zh: : 我他妈刚说了什么？！这下会更痛了，你这饥渴的臭婊子！

lines.en: : SOMEONE...NGACKHH...HELP....ME! I CAN’T....I CAN’T....GET HIM...OFF OF ME!
lines.zh: : 来人……嗯啊咳……救救……我！我弄不……我弄不……把他……从我身上弄下来！

lines.en: : You know you...fuckin’ like it! You love my fucking cock! Say it! Say it!
lines.zh: : 你明明……他妈的喜欢！你爱我的鸡巴！说！说出来！

lines.en: : NGFHHHFGHHHPFFHTTT!!!!  MMMNNNGNHGHGHGH?!??!?!?!
lines.zh: : NGFHHHFGHHHPFFHTTT！！！！ MMMNNNGNHGHGHGH？！？？！？！？！

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus2
: I’m gonna cum.....I’m-
lines.zh: : 我要去了……我——

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus3
: Hey, Sana. Sorry to wake you up, but I’m back a little early.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sana。抱歉吵醒你，不过我回来得有点早。

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus4
: My breakfast plans didn’t last as long as I expected. Apparently, Makoto agreed to head over to the hotel early to start decorating with Miku and Futaba. And Maya just...didn’t even show up.
lines.zh: : 我的早餐计划没持续到我以为的那么久。看来 Makoto 答应提早去酒店，跟 Miku 和 Futaba 一起布置。而 Maya 干脆……连人都没露面。

lines.en: : On top of that, Ami {i}still{/i} won’t let me see Sensei. And even Geoffrey is busy today since he’s going to an indoor skating rink with his previously-estranged son.
lines.zh: : 而且 Ami 仍然不让我见 Sensei。连 Geoffrey 今天也忙，他要和之前疏远的儿子去室内溜冰场。

lines.en: : It’s like everyone is getting off to a fun Christmas start without me and I just have to suffer.
lines.zh: : 就好像所有人都扔下我，开始享受一个愉快的圣诞开端，而我只能受苦。

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus5
: But hey, story of my life at this point. You know?
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，到这地步这就是我的人生故事了。你懂吧？

lines.en: : Hahah! Sure do!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！当然懂！

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus6
: Um...what are you doing?
lines.zh: : 呃……你在干什么？

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus7
: P...Push-ups?...
lines.zh: : 俯……俯卧撑？……

lines.en: : Um...{i}why?{/i} And why aren’t you asleep? You’re never out of bed this early.
lines.zh: : 呃……为什么？还有你怎么还没睡？你从来不会这么早起。

lines.en: : I...I decided to...start exercising?
lines.zh: : 我……我决定……开始锻炼？

lines.en: : Well, that would certainly explain why your face is beet-red. But it doesn’t really explain why you’re pressing down on your laptop for dear-
lines.zh: : 嗯，那确实能解释你为什么满脸通红。可还是解释不了你为什么死死按着你的笔记本电脑——

lines.en: : Wait, isn’t that {i}my{/i} laptop?
lines.zh: : 等等，那不是我的笔记本电脑吗？

lines.en: : No. This one is mine. Yours is...yours is in the shop.
lines.zh: : 不是。这台是我的。你那台……你那台在店里修。

lines.en: : The shop?
: I broke it.
lines.zh: : 我弄坏了。

lines.en: : You...broke my-
lines.zh: : 你弄坏了我的——

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus8
: M...Merry Christmas! And...welcome back!
lines.zh: : 圣……圣诞快乐！还有……欢迎回来！

lines.en: : You’re up to something, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你在搞什么鬼，对吧？

lines.en: : No!
lines.zh: : 没有！

lines.en: : Sana...
lines.zh: : Sana……

lines.en: : That’s me! Normal Sana! Who isn’t ever up to anything!
lines.zh: : 我就是啊！正常的 Sana！从来不搞任何名堂！

lines.en: : Hah...whatever. You’re the only close friend I have who’s yet to let me down, so I guess I’ll just take your word for it.
lines.zh: : 哈……随便吧。你是我唯一一个还没让我失望的亲密朋友，所以我想我就信你一回好了。

lines.en: scene black
: Also, why are you still in the dark if you’re awake? You’re going to go blind if you keep this up.
lines.zh: : 还有，你既然醒着，怎么还待在黑暗里？再这样下去你会瞎的。

lines.en: : That’s okay! I’m used to...only using one eye anyway!
lines.zh: : 没关系！反正我也习惯……只用一只眼睛了！

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus9
: Come to think of it, why {i}did{/i} you start pulling your hair back? Everybody knew you as a cyclops and now you’re suddenly just a normal girl.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你为什么开始把头发往后梳了？大家以前都把你当成独眼龙，现在你突然就是个普通女孩了。

lines.en: : That’s...me...A normal girl...
lines.zh: : 那……就是我……一个普通的女孩……

lines.en: : I just...you know...it was time for a...change and stuff...
lines.zh: : 我只是……你知道……是时候做点……改变了什么的……

lines.en: : I’m a lot more...um...outgoing than I used to be, so...two eyes is...it’s fine now...
lines.zh: : 我比以前……嗯……开朗多了，所以……两只眼睛……现在也没问题了……

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 是吗……

lines.en: : Right...
: You know you don’t have to keep your hands on-
lines.zh: : 你知道你不用一直把手放在——

lines.en: : I’m good. Just ignore where my hands are and tell me more about your breakfast.
lines.zh: : 我没事。别管我的手在哪儿，多说说你那顿早餐吧。

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus10
: Right — the breakfast. Like I said, Makoto bailed and Maya didn’t show up. And when I went to Maya’s dorm just now, she wasn’t there. So either she was kidnapped, she died, or I was stood up.
lines.zh: : 对——早餐。就像我说的，Makoto 跑了，Maya 没来。而我刚才去 Maya 的宿舍，她也不在。所以要么她被绑架了，要么她死了，要么我被放了鸽子。

lines.en: : And none of those things are good, but I’d feel particularly let down if it happened to be the latter-most of those options.
lines.zh: : 这几样都不好，不过要是偏偏是最后那一种，我会特别失落。

lines.en: : And...umm...what was the reason for this breakfast again?...
lines.zh: : 还有……呃……这顿早餐的原因又是什么来着？……

lines.en: : Something about fixing the infinite timeloop we’re all-
lines.zh: : 好像是关于修复我们都困在其中的那个无限时间循环——

lines.en: : Sorry, could you...speak up a little? I can’t really hear-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你能……大点声吗？我听不太——

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus11
: We’re all caught in a timeloop and every time I try to tell you-
lines.zh: : 我们都困在一个时间循环里，而每次我试图告诉你们——

lines.en: : Sorry, but...I still can’t really hear you...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，可是……我还是听不太清你在说什么……

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus10
: Hah...let’s just say I had something to discuss with the two of them about...school.
lines.zh: : 哈……就当是我有关于……学校的事跟她们俩商量吧。

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus12
: School? Does it have something to do with Miss Imai becoming our new full-time teacher? Because I’ve heard that some of the other girls have a problem with that as well...
lines.zh: : 学校？是不是跟 Imai 老师要成为我们新的全职老师有关？因为我听说其他一些女生对这事也有意见……

lines.en: : Something about...too much homework or...something...
lines.zh: : 好像是……作业太多还是什么的……

lines.en: : She’s not our new full-time teacher, Sana. Sensei’s going to come back. She’s just filling in for him until he does.
lines.zh: : 她不是我们新的全职老师，Sana。Sensei 会回来的。她只是在他回来之前代课。

lines.en: : Y...Yeah. But...on the off-chance that he {i}doesn’t{/i} come back...she’ll be the full-time teacher...right?
lines.zh: : 是……是啊。可是……万一他真的不回来了……她就会是全职老师……对吧？

lines.en: : Because I’ve already gotten used to her, but...a third teacher sounds like...a little much...you know?...
lines.zh: : 因为我已经习惯她了，可是……第三位老师听起来……有点太多了……你知道吗？……

lines.en: : And I don’t really think I would survive in Miss Watabe’s class, so...
lines.zh: : 而且我真不觉得自己在 Watabe 老师的班上能活下来，所以……

lines.en: : Sana, Sensei {i}is{/i} going to come back. I just need to figure out a way to get past Ami so I can talk to him and tell him that this new cycle isn’t as bad as he thinks it is. I think there’s hope.
lines.zh: : Sana，Sensei 一定会回来的。我只需要想办法绕过 Ami，好跟他谈一谈，告诉他这个新循环并没有他以为的那么糟。我觉得还有希望。

lines.en: : Sorry, I didn’t really hear that...could you say it again?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我没太听清……能再说一遍吗？

lines.en: : Sensei’s going to come back and Miss Imai is going to return to being a cool student-teacher instead of an {i}actual{/i} teacher who makes us learn actual things.
lines.zh: : Sensei 会回来，而 Imai 老师会重新变回那个很酷的实习老师，而不是一个真让我们学真东西的真正的老师。

lines.en: : That’s a relief because...I don’t enjoy learning new things very much...
lines.zh: : 那就好，因为……我不太喜欢学新东西……

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus13
: At this point, I’m pretty tired of that as well.
lines.zh: : 到这一步，我也挺厌倦那件事了。

lines.en: : It might sound a little rude, so please don’t repeat this to anyone, but I’ve had this feeling for a little while now that I’m the only person around here with her head screwed all the way on. No offense.
lines.zh: : 这话可能有点失礼，请别转述给别人听，不过我有一阵子一直有这种感觉——这附近只有我一个人的脑袋是完全正常的。无意冒犯。

lines.en: : Uh...none...taken?...
lines.zh: : 呃……没有……被冒犯？……

lines.en: : I just mean that everybody around me has been bashing their head in trying to understand or...{i}explain{/i} things so intensely that they’ve like...killed half their braincells or something.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，我身边的每个人都在拼命把头往墙上撞，试图理解或者{i}解释{/i}某些事，激烈得像是……已经把自己一半的脑细胞撞死了。

lines.en: : And now that Maya is a completely different person and Sensei isn’t even around, it’s making me feel like I’m the only {i}actual{/i} human left in this world. Again, no offense.
lines.zh: : 而现在 Maya 变成了完全不同的人，Sensei 又根本不在，这让我觉得自己是这世界上唯一剩下的真正的人。再说一次，无意冒犯。

lines.en: : Again, none taken...but...what do you mean by “Maya is a completely different person?...”
lines.zh: : 再说一次，没有被冒犯……可是……「Maya 是完全不同的人」是什么意思？……

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus14
: Well, like...you know how, in the beginning of the school year, Sensei felt kind of...off? Like a switch just flipped in his head all of a sudden and he became the person we know him as today?
lines.zh: : 嗯，就是……你还记得学年刚开始的时候 Sensei 感觉有点……不对劲吗？就像他脑子里某个开关突然被拨了一下，然后他就变成了我们今天认识的那个人？

lines.en: : D...Did something like that happen?...Because I don’t...I don’t really remember that...
lines.zh: : 有……有过这种事吗？……因为我不……我实在不记得了……

lines.en: : Maybe I just noticed it because I’ve been watching him for so long, but yeah. That happened. And, in a certain sense, I think that may have happened to Maya as well.
lines.zh: : 也许只是因为我盯着他看了太久才注意到，不过是的。那确实发生了。而在某种意义上，我觉得同样的事可能也发生在了 Maya 身上。

lines.en: : You really haven’t noticed her acting differently? Because I know you two weren’t exactly {i}close,{/i} but you did talk sometimes. And to me it’s like...night and day.
lines.zh: : 你真的没注意到她表现得不一样吗？我知道你们俩算不上亲密，可你们有时候也会说话。而对我来说，那简直是天壤之别。

lines.en: : I...um...well...different {i}how{/i} exactly?...
lines.zh: : 我……呃……那个……具体是什么不同？……

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus15
: Like...uh...she’s even more {i}Maya{/i} than usual?...Or something?...
lines.zh: : 就是……呃……她比平时还要「{i}Maya{/i}」？……还是什么的？……

lines.en: : Uhh...
: It’s hard to explain. It just feels...wrong.
lines.zh: : 很难解释。就是感觉……不对劲。

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus16
: I...haven’t really noticed that...
lines.zh: : 我……确实没注意到那个……

lines.en: : In fact, I haven’t really...noticed {i}anyone{/i} acting any differently than normal...but I don’t know how long you’ve been feeling like you’re the only human, so...
lines.zh: : 事实上，我也没……注意到任何人表现得跟平时不一样……不过我不知道你这种{i}唯一的人类{/i}的感觉持续多久了，所以……

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it, Sana. I’m kind of just venting at this point since all of the people I normally get to vent to have abandoned me.
lines.zh: : 别在意了，Sana。我这会儿只是在发泄，毕竟平时听我发牢骚的人都把我抛弃了。

lines.en: : I mean...{i}I’m{/i} still here?...
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}我{/i}还在这儿啊？……

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus17
: I know. Like I said, you’re the only person who’s yet to let me down.
lines.zh: : 我知道。就像我说的，你是唯一一个还没让我失望的人。

lines.en: : But even {i}you{/i} have seemed a little...off lately. And by lately I mean...basically the entire summer. And also now. But hey, that might just be me not being ready for you to grow up yet.
lines.zh: : 可就连{i}你{/i}最近也有点……不对劲。而「最近」我指的是……基本整个夏天。还有现在。不过嘿，也许只是我还没准备好看你长大。

lines.en: : Either way, I’m sure you have your reasons for whatever is going on. And I’m not going to pry since it would probably just make you uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我相信你有什么理由。我不会刨根问底，因为那大概只会让你不舒服。

lines.en: : Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus18
: {i}I’m really not.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我真的不好。{/i}

lines.en: : But as the self-proclaimed final human on the face of the earth, it’s up to me to stay strong.
lines.zh: : 但作为自封的「地球上最后一个人」，我得坚强起来。

lines.en: : There’s a time for tears and that time isn’t now, Sana.
lines.zh: : 该哭的时候会有的，而那个时刻不是现在，Sana。

lines.en: : I’m...impressed you can say that while crying...
lines.zh: : 我……很佩服你能一边哭一边说出这种话……

lines.en: : These aren’t tears...My eyes are just sweating.
lines.zh: : 这不是眼泪……我的眼睛只是在出汗。

lines.en: : I don’t think it works that way...
lines.zh: : 我觉得不是这么运作的……

lines.en: : Sana, you don’t have to worry about me. Just...keep being you and that’ll be more than enough. But also, feel free to slow down the growth a little bit if you want. I won’t mind.
lines.zh: : Sana，你不用担心我。只要……继续做你自己就足够了。不过要是你愿意，也可以把长大的速度放慢一点。我不会介意的。

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus19
: I really wish I could...and you’re right, I think. I probably {i}have{/i} been acting differently.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我能……而你说得对，我想。我大概确实表现得不一样了。

lines.en: : I’ve been...I’ve been {i}feeling{/i} differently...
lines.zh: : 我一直在……我一直在有不同的感觉……

lines.en: : And I can’t really remember how it started, but...I think you might be right when you say it was summer...
lines.zh: : 而我不太记得是从什么时候开始的，不过……你说是在夏天，我觉得可能是对的……

lines.en: : It’s like...um...I don’t know if...using that “switch flipping” thing you said earlier is entirely accurate, but...maybe it’s easier for people to change than I thought?...
lines.zh: : 就像……嗯……我不知道用你刚才说的那个「开关被拨」的说法是不是完全准确，不过……也许人比我想象的更容易改变？……

lines.en: : When {i}you’re{/i} the one changing...you never really know until it’s already over...
lines.zh: : 当在改变的人是{i}你{/i}自己……你往往要到一切都结束了才会知道……

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus20
: Like...you, for example...
: Me? What about me? I don’t think I’ve changed all that much.
lines.zh: : 我？我怎么了？我不觉得自己变了多少啊。

lines.en: : To me...you’ve changed more than anyone...but all of those changes have been good things...
lines.zh: : 对我来说……你改变得比任何人都多……但那些改变全都是好的……

lines.en: : You seem...stronger now...even when you’re upset...
lines.zh: : 你看起来……变强了……哪怕是在难过的时候……

lines.en: : Like...you went off on your own and...grinded a bunch of XP without inviting the rest of us...
lines.zh: : 就像……你自己一个人去……刷了一大堆经验值，都没叫上我们……

lines.en: : Does...does that make sense?...
lines.zh: : 这……这说得通吗？……

lines.en: : Honestly?...Yeah. Yeah, I think it does. And in a roundabout way, I think you’re right. About that {i}and{/i} how it’s hard to recognize any of that when you’re the subject.
lines.zh: : 说实话？……嗯。嗯，我觉得说得通。而且绕了一圈，我觉得你是对的——关于那一点，也关于当局者迷这一点。

lines.en: : Exactly...
lines.zh: : 就是啊……

lines.en: : So...maybe it’s just the level gap that’s...making you feel like you’re the only human left on the face of the earth...
lines.zh: : 所以……也许只是等级差……才让你觉得自己是地球上唯一剩下的人……

lines.en: : And maybe the rest of us just...need to catch back up or something...
lines.zh: : 而我们其余人大概只是……需要追上来什么的……

lines.en: : But...just because you’re a higher level doesn’t mean it’s {i}your{/i} responsibility to carry us through dungeons...
lines.zh: : 可是……就算你等级高，也不代表带我们通关副本是你的责任……

lines.en: : We can party up on our own...take down bosses without your help...and maybe one day, we’ll all be looking down at you...
lines.zh: : 我们可以自己组队……不用你帮忙也能推倒boss……而且也许有一天，会轮到我们所有人低头看你……

lines.en: : So...do yourself a favor and...take a break every once in a while...
lines.zh: : 所以……帮自己个忙，偶尔……休息一下吧……

lines.en: : You’ve earned it.
lines.zh: : 这是你应得的。

lines.en: : Wow...
: What?...
: That was just...like...
lines.zh: : 那番话……怎么说呢……

lines.en: : Have you been taking public speaking classes or something?
lines.zh: : 你是不是去上了什么公开演讲课？

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus21
: I used to.
lines.zh: : 以前上过。

lines.en: : Not so much anymore.
lines.zh: : 现在不太上了。

lines.en: : Either way, that was an amazing analogy and...pretty much all of it hit the nail on the head.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，那个比喻太棒了……而且几乎每一点都说到了点子上。

lines.en: : I’ve been trying to take more breaks. I really have. I made it my one and only goal and everything.
lines.zh: : 我一直在努力多休息。真的。我甚至把它立成了我唯一的目标。

lines.en: : But these days, it feels like God is toying with me — throwing every conceivable obstacle right at my face as I’m trying to relax. And that makes it really hard, Sana. {i}Really{/i} hard.
lines.zh: : 可这些日子，感觉就像上帝在耍我——每当我想放松，就把一切想得到的障碍直接砸到我脸上。这让我很难办，Sana。真的很难。

lines.en: : Just like with crying, though...there’s a time for breaks and a time to get serious. And I don’t even think my mind would {i}let{/i} me rest before I figure out what’s going on with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 不过就像哭一样……该休息的时候休息，该认真的时候认真。而且我觉得在弄清楚 Sensei 到底怎么回事之前，我的脑子根本不会让我休息。

lines.en: : I hope you figure it out soon...
lines.zh: : 我希望你快点弄明白……

lines.en: : I’m getting tired of all the homework...
lines.zh: : 我快被作业烦死了……

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus22
: Luckily for you, you’ll get at least {i}tonight{/i} off from doing homework as I volunteered you to come decorate for the Christmas party with me.
lines.zh: : 你运气不错，至少{i}今晚{/i}不用写作业了——我替你报名来跟我一起布置圣诞派对。

lines.en: : I take back everything I said tonight and I hate you.
lines.zh: : 我收回今晚说的一切，我恨你。

lines.en: : I haven’t even bought my Secret Santa present yet.
lines.zh: : 我连秘密圣诞老人的礼物都还没买呢。

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus23
: Oh crap! I’ve been so busy trying to save the world that I forgot to do that as well.
lines.zh: : 靠！我忙着拯救世界，连这个也忘了。

lines.en: : Can I use your laptop for a second? I get guaranteed one-hour delivery since I’m subscribed to Amazon Optimus Prime. And I already have stuff saved in my wishlist for-
lines.zh: : 我能用一下你的笔记本电脑吗？因为我订阅了 Amazon Optimus Prime，保证一小时送达。而且我的愿望清单里已经存了东西——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : No?
lines.zh: : 不行？

lines.en: : This one is broken too.
lines.zh: : 这台也坏了。

lines.en: scene jillingforjesus24
: Sana...
lines.zh: : Sana……

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Is there something on that laptop you don’t want me to see?
lines.zh: : 那台电脑上有什么你不想让我看到的东西吗？

lines.en: : Have you considered that maybe there is something on this laptop that {i}you{/i} don’t want to see?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}有没有想过，也许这台电脑上有的是你不想看到的东西？

lines.en: : I am going to go take a shower now. Please take as much time as you need to destroy the evidence.
lines.zh: : 我现在去洗澡了。请慢慢来，花多少时间销毁证据都行。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : Then neither do I.
lines.zh: : 那我也不知道。

lines.en: scene black
Ayane takes a shower.
lines.zh: Ayane 去洗澡了。

lines.en: Sana never reaches orgasm.
lines.zh: Sana 始终没能高潮。

lines.zh: {i}从你可悲的、自找的昏迷里醒过来，去把她用手弄哭吧！你现在被允许这么做了！{/i}
